name: release-engineering
description: The release-engineering role directive and phase-1/phase-2 norm composer on contract v3 (issue-33): itself owns no methodology gate. Phase 1 = proposal-norm alone; phase 2 = readiness-checklist + rollout-plan + error-budget-policy + postmortem, composed. This plugin's directive.sh concatenates each enabled sibling plugin's own directive-fragment.txt into HAND_OFF at SessionStart, instead of hand-writing all four facets itself.

dependencies.note: Requires the core and warrant plugins from tokenmaxxxer-core, plus this repo's proposal-norm, readiness-checklist, rollout-plan, error-budget-policy, and postmortem plugins, installed alongside this plugin. on-the-record installs them per role; this field only documents the requirement.
